rationale: The Latin anchors *micare* ("to flash/gleam") and *dealbari*/*dealbabor* ("to be made white/to shine") point to an intransitive sense of emitting or radiating light/brightness, which aligns best with shine.v.02 ("emit light; be bright"). The Psalm contexts ("I shall appear in justice" / "I shall be whiter than snow") confirm a sense of shining forth or becoming brilliantly bright, rather than reflecting light from another source (reflect.v.04) or a metaphorical eminence (shine.v.04).
